requested_scope: Full audit and remediation of all issues found, including still-open P2-1 through P2-7 and signup plan/billing handoff; commit, merge PR to main, and push live. The original goal remains incomplete while historical findings, backend rollout and release access are unresolved.
scope: Dashboard, ingestion, reporting, settings and chat
Server tenant/billing boundaries and existing regression coverage
Dependencies, runtime packaging, CI and test portability
Review of draft PR 35 rollout prerequisites

fixed.issue: Signup's selected plan was not shown, and the configured emailed-code verification path had no code input. Signup also sent an unallowlisted /login redirect intended for link verification.
fixed.change: Read and display the validated plan and billing interval; use code verification with resend and refresh recovery; resume the exact checkout destination after immediate signup or verification. Preserve existing OAuth and authenticated visitor intent paths.
fixed.tests: 18 signup/intent regressions; real bundled SDK with mocked auth and checkout in desktop/mobile Chrome

fixed.issue: Annual and Pro signup advertised a free trial although those checkout prices are not trial eligible.
fixed.change: Show payment and trial copy for the selected plan and interval.

fixed.issue: App checkout receiver accepted unknown plans and trailing segments.
fixed.change: Validate an exact starter/growth/pro and monthly/annual checkout trigger.

fixed.issue: Email forms remained active while OAuth was pending.
fixed.change: Disable and guard email submission during a provider handoff.

fixed.issue: Forgot-password navigation discarded plan/billing query parameters.
fixed.change: Retain query parameters through the reset and return-to-login path.

fixed.issue: Dashboard multiplied null trend values into 0% and rounded small inventories to whole zero tonnes.
fixed.change: Preserve null comparisons and display totals to two decimal places.

fixed.issue: Dashboard, CSV upload, billing, report generation/download, and blog fetches could leave the UI waiting indefinitely.
fixed.change: Bound those HTTP requests to 15 seconds.

fixed.issue: CSV upload read oversized files before server rejection.
fixed.change: Check the 100 KiB body limit before reading the file.
Fall back to an in-memory chat identifier.

fixed.issue: Inline dialog close callbacks restarted the focus trap on every edit.
fixed.change: Keep the trap mounted while updating the close callback through a ref.

fixed.issue: Onboarding treated a failed company lookup as an absent company and attempted to create it.
fixed.change: Surface the lookup failure before any company or facility write and allow retry.
fixed.tests: React regression verifies no insert/update/completion on lookup failure and an enabled retry button.

fixed.issue: CI only linted selected files and push verification excluded main.
fixed.change: Lint the repository and run push verification on both main and master.

fixed.issue: Database regression suites depended on C:/Users/embro/bootstrap-auth-e2e.sql, unavailable in CI.
fixed.change: Commit a minimal disposable-database auth fixture and resolve it relative to the repository.

fixed.issue: Vulnerable brace-expansion and Undici versions were pinned/resolved; CSS build tools were shipped in the runtime image.
fixed.change: Apply compatible brace-expansion patches and Undici 7.30.0; move CSS tooling to devDependencies; pin Tailwind to 3.4.19. Production audit reports zero vulnerabilities.

fixed.issue: The security audit script failed on Windows when Node's executable path contained spaces.
fixed.change: Invoke the Node executable without shell interpretation.
